reviews.comment: Dr. Mohsen is by far the best professor I have had yet. While lectures can be slow, he made sure everyone understood the material and was ready for exams. You definitely have to do really well on the exams to get an A in the class (I'm a bad test taker, so this was a personal issue), but test averages were always good. Definitely recommend!!

One of my favorite professors in this university. Goes over topics slowly, grades tests easy and has high averages. The total grade dist is 80% tests so I would warn you that you need high test grades for A. But tests are very similar to homeworks which he goes over in classes and posts solutions later to study. Test averages were aroun 83/84!

Pourahmadi has a sense of humor but will call on people randomly since that's how he learns (mostly) everyone's names. Lectures were slow. The new grading scale (60% for 2 exams, 20% project and report, and 20% HW) was ok, just do all HW and ask questions in OH to him and the TA. DO EXAM REVIEWS AND HW for similar exam practice...
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took STAT 408 with Dr. Pourahmadi Spring 2021, online. Although his lectures can be slow and make you sleepy, it is definitely slow paced and not difficult to follow. He announces a week in advance when his quizzes are during lecture. Homeworks can be long, but attend recitation for help. Very nice and understanding prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is good at teaching. He made the material easy to comprehend and fun to learn. He encourages class participation. Sample exams are given before exams to help prepare. You can bring in a single side sheet of notes for each exam. Ten homeworks were assigned and the r codes needed were given in the lecture notes.
I loved Mohsen. He's very chill and his class wasn't overly difficult. He makes things make sense and cares about his students.
